cues: You will be asked to name a bundle, not just describe it.
Radial: xylem and phloem on different radii, in roots.
Conjoint and collateral: phloem only on the outside, as in most stems.
Bicollateral: phloem on both sides of the xylem, in the pumpkin family, Cucurbitaceae, and in Solanum.
